Comment: Naleko HR Portal — Onboarding flow orchestration (NH-42, ONB-11). Triggered by createEmployee Lambda after DynamoDB write. Waits until every required document is in (processDocumentOCR signals it), runs the Bedrock risk check once, then publishes onboarding.risk_assessed (or onboarding.failed) to the naleko-onboarding EventBridge bus. The true onboarding.completed is published by reviewDocumentVerification when HR accepts the last required document.

CreateEmployee.Comment: Employee was created synchronously by the API Gateway → createEmployee Lambda before this execution started. This Pass state marks the conceptual start of the orchestrated flow and forwards the employeeId to WaitForDocumentUpload.

WaitForDocumentUpload.Comment: Uses the DynamoDB SDK integration with waitForTaskToken. Writes the task token + execution ARN onto the employee record. processDocumentOCR reads this token when a read moves the person to In review (every required document is in) and calls sfn:SendTaskSuccess to resume the execution. Waits up to 30 days; nothing sends heartbeats.

Catch.Comment: Document wait timed out (30 days) or task failed - fire onboarding.failed event
Catch-all for any other error during document wait

AssessRisk.Comment: Invokes classifyOnboardingRisk (flow entry) with only the source and the employee id. The Lambda takes the company from the employee's own row and answers { employeeId, tenantId, riskBand, riskReason, riskAssessedAt }.

Retry.Comment: Retry transient Lambda failures twice with exponential backoff before failing the execution

RiskAssessed.Comment: Publishes onboarding.risk_assessed to the naleko-onboarding EventBridge bus (audit log). It does not say onboarding is completed: HR has decided nothing yet.

OnboardingFailed.Comment: Catch-all failure state. Publishes onboarding.failed to EventBridge. Downstream consumers (e.g. sendNotificationEmail) can send HR alert emails.
